label: Population density (WorldPop 2020, 1 km)
summary: People per square kilometre in 2020, WorldPop's top-down constrained estimate: census totals disaggregated to 30 arcseconds by settlement, land cover, night lights and roads.
credit: WorldPop (2020), Global 1 km population, University of Southampton
note: ppp_2020_1km_Aggregated.tif from data.worldpop.org, rewritten as a COG (Float32, DEFLATE, predictor 3, 512 blocks, average overviews). The source stores population COUNT per 1 km cell, which at 30 arcseconds is people per km2 to within the cell's own aspect; the card converts with the cell's true area. grid/bounds are rewritten by bake-worldpop.py from the file.
